name: Tanmay Shukla
tagline: Third-year Physics undergrad at IIT Kanpur (minor in Space, Planetary & Astronomical Sciences & Engineering), working across astrophysics research, machine learning, and data pipelines.
about: I'm a third-year B.S. Physics student at IIT Kanpur, minoring in Space, Planetary & Astronomical Sciences & Engineering. I work on astrophysics research (circumgalactic medium modelling, pulsar detection, VLBI imaging) and build ML/data pipelines for problems in astronomy, finance, and computer vision — mostly through the Astronomy Club at IIT Kanpur, where I also mentor projects as Secretary.
